newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror Co Q4 shr $0.67 after charges.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror Co Q4 shr $0.67 after charges.

text.p: (In thousands, except share and per share amounts)
Premium paid for Series B preferred
(a) Includes $67.3 million of nonrecurring costs in 1995.
(b) Net interest income in the fourth quarter of 1996 resulted from the Company's decision to terminate its company-owned life insurance program as a result of tax law changes.
(c) This amount, along with preferred dividend requirements, reduces earnings applicable to common shareholders for purposes of determining earnings per share.

(d) A comparison of income (loss) and earnings (loss) per share (EPS) from continuing operations, excluding restructuring, asset sales and special items, presented on an after-tax basis, is as follows:
(dollars in millions, Primary Diluted Primary Diluted

(e) Preferred dividend requirements for fully diluted earnings per share are $8.2 million since fully diluted assumes conversion of the Series B preferred stock. (f) Weighted average common and common equivalent shares calculation includes the effects of the Company's repurchases of its common stock. During the fourth quarter of 1996 and 1995, the Company repurchased 2.8 million and 4.6 million common shares, respectively.

(g) Common stock equivalents of 3.6 million shares are included in 1996. For 1995, common stock equivalents of 2.4 million shares are not included in weighted average shares because they are antidilutive due to the loss in that period.
FOOTNOTES TO YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31 RESULTS
(a) Includes $90.0 million of nonrecurring costs in 1995.

(b) The effective tax rates for 1996 and 1995 operating results, excluding net gains on asset sales/write-downs and restructuring charges, were 41.5 percent and 48.6 percent, respectively. The tax rate derived for 1996 of 48.9 percent includes the net tax provision for asset sales/write-downs, among other adjustments.
(c) This amount, along with preferred dividend requirements, reduces earnings applicable to common shareholders for purposes of determining earnings per share.

(d) A comparison of income (loss) and earnings (loss) per share (EPS) from continuing operations, excluding restructuring, asset sales and special items, presented on an after-tax basis, is as follows:
(dollars in millions, Primary Diluted Primary Diluted

(e) Preferred dividend requirements for fully diluted earnings per share are $32.9 million and $27.5 million for 1996 and 1995 respectively, since fully diluted assumes conversion of the Series B preferred stock.

(f) Weighted average common and common equivalent shares calculation includes the effects of the Company's repurchases of its common stock. During 1996 and 1995, the Company repurchased 11.4 million and 7.0 million common shares, respectively.

(g) Common stock equivalents of 3.0 million shares are included in 1996. For 1995, common stock equivalents of 1.7 million shares are not included because the dilution is less than 3%, and is not significant.
